name: io.github.boradenizarol-svg/efatura
title: e-Fatura API (Turkish e-invoice parser)
description: Parse Turkish e-invoices (GİB UBL-TR e-Fatura XML) to JSON with VAT/VKN checks. Pay per invoice.

tools.name: parse_efatura
tools.description: Reads one Turkish e-invoice (e-Fatura/e-Arşiv, UBL-TR 1.2 XML) and returns invoice number, ETTN, dates, supplier/customer (name, VKN/TCKN, tax office), lines, taxes (KDV, ÖTV), withholdings (tevkifat), totals, and a list of consistency checks. Costs $0.01 per successfully parsed invoice; failed parses are free. Provide either xml (raw text) or xmlBase64.

xmlBase64.description: Invoice XML file as base64 (use for non-UTF-8 files)

tools.name: efatura_demo
tools.description: Free. Returns parse_efatura output for a fictional sample invoice so you can see the JSON format.
